Hi Alex —

Great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary of what I heard:
- You want to evaluate Redwood for prompt-driven data enrichment and summarization for your search product.
- Expected ramp: ~100M tokens/month in Q1 pilot, scaling to ~400M tokens/month by end of year.
- Key constraints: predictable unit cost, ability to lock in committed pricing, and SOC2 evidence for procurement.

Initial pricing notes:
- Startup program: qualifies startups (criteria below) for 30% off first 3 months + waived onboarding fee.
- Committed-use (12-month): we can offer a committed-use discount that targets ~40-50% off list depending on token commitment.
- Multi-year (24-month): typically a further 5-10% incentive layered on top of committed-use discounts for multi-year deals.

Action items / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the monthly token volumes you expect in months 1/3/6/12? (you mentioned ~100M -> 400M monthly).
2) What is your target unit economics (target $/1M tokens) so I can map discount tiers to your target?
3) Procurement: please send any standard procurement/PO requirements and the contact (I see procurement@datasync.ai on copy).
4) I attached our updated pricing_sheet_v2.pdf for reference and a short checklist for the startup program qualification.

If it helps I can pull pricing examples that map to your volumes and show net $/1M tokens at: no-commit, 12-mo commit, and 24-mo commit with startup credits applied.

Would you be open to a 30-min call tomorrow to review the numbers and put a mutual action plan together?

Thanks —
Ben

Thanks Ben — really helpful recap. A few clarifications and our numbers: 

Volumes (expected):
- Pilot (months 0-3): ~100M tokens / month
- Post-pilot (months 4-6): ~200-250M tokens / month
- Q4 steady state: ~350-450M tokens / month

Budget / target unit economics:
- Current budget range: $12k-$20k / month during pilot; looking to expand to $60k+/month at scale.
- Target net price: ~ $30 / 1M tokens (this is our negotiating target after discounts/commitments).

We are a seed-stage startup (YC S21), so we'd like to know whether we qualify for the startup program and the specific discounts. Procurement has a couple of standard items (SOC2 attestation, DPA, and a short SOW) — I attached our requirements doc.

Next steps for us: please send concrete pricing examples that map to the volumes above and show net $/1M tokens for no-commit, 12-month commit, and 24-month commit, factoring in startup credits. Also confirm any minimum spend for committed tiers and whether multi-year pricing requires an upfront payment or monthly billing.

Happy to do a call tomorrow at 11am PT if that works for you.

Thanks Alex — this is perfect and exactly what I needed. Please see the concrete answers below and a couple of recommended paths.

Quick answers:
- Startup program: Based on YC + seed-stage status you look eligible. That would give 30% credit on invoice for first 3 months and waiver of the $5k onboarding fee (one-time). I’ll need a short sign-off doc from you to confirm eligibility.
- 12-month commit example: if you commit to 2B tokens over 12 months (~166M tokens/month avg), we can provide a 45% discount off list, which maps roughly to $~55 / 1M tokens net (example numbers in attached sheet).
- 24-month multi-year incentive: add ~8% additional rebate over the 12-month committed price (applied as quarterly credits). That can get net price closer to your target depending on commitment size.

Note on your target ($30 / 1M tokens): at volumes in the 350-450M/month range, a 24-month commit with bridging credits + startup promo could potentially approach your target, but it depends on how aggressive you want to lock capacity vs. paid-as-you-go. I’ll model two scenarios on today’s call:
  A) Lower upfront commit, higher per-token price but monthly billing
  B) Higher commit (multi-year) with lower net $/1M tokens and quarterly credits applied

Minimums / billing:
- Committed tiers: minimum 1B tokens / 12-month for tier pricing to apply (we can structure smaller pilots with step-down pricing).
- Multi-year incentive: typically we bill monthly and apply credits quarterly, but prepayment can be arranged for additional discount.

I attached an updated pricing_sheet_v2.pdf that includes scenario tables mapping to your volumes and net $/1M tokens under the different options.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll model the exact net $/1M numbers for the three scenarios and share by EOD.
2) If the numbers look good, we’ll draft a short order form + MSA to lock in the committed terms.
3) If you qualify for startup credits, we’ll issue a short eligibility confirmation doc for your records.

Would you still like to do 11am PT today? If so I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best —
Ben
